name: Smith Machine Decline Wide-Grip Bench Press
steps: Set a decline bench so the bar tracks over your lower chest, secure your feet and lie back.
Brace your trunk, set your shoulder blades against the pad and take a wide overhand grip before releasing the hooks.
Lower the bar smoothly down toward your lower chest while keeping your forearms vertical underneath your hands.
Press the bar up until your arms straighten and secure the hooks when finished.
tips: Avoid gripping so excessively wide that your shoulders feel pinched at the bottom.
Keep your elbows slightly below shoulder level rather than flaring straight toward your ears.
